title: Safety Last!
director: Fred C. Newmeyer and Sam Taylor
licence: Public domain in the United States (published before 1929); original print from the Internet Archive

provenance.notes: Gemini (tools/cue-sheet.mjs, Files API, 2 fps) proposed 16 cues (public/clips/safety-last.proposed.json). Checked against 1 s and 0.25 s contact sheets of this clip. Kept with the same prop: Harold swings onto the clock 4.2 -> 4.5, dangles from the clock 14.5 -> 13.9, the cop enters 37.5 -> 39.0 (he appears in the doorway at 39.0), Harold swings out on the rope 85.0 -> 86.0 (relabelled from 'slides on pipe') and the cop and pal tumble 117.5 -> 118.7; the clock face opening was right but early (10.0 -> 11.9, outside the script's 1.5 s pairing). Moments kept with another prop: the scramble round the desk 40.0 (thunder -> coconuts) and the pal dragged into the chair 60.5 (thunder -> glass). Dropped: 0.5 (the pal leaving the window, before the clip settles), 28.0 'clock face rumbles', 46.0, 52.0, 63.0 and 97.0 (Harold hanging on, no hit), 74.0 'officer hits friend' (the cop only collars him), 79.5 'man falls further' (nobody falls). Added by hand: the rope dropped from the cornice 32.6, the drunk man's guffaw 88.3 (the punchline before the title card), Harold slipping down the rope 113.0, and the wrestle 77.0. 6 of 16 proposals survived the hand check (5 as paired by the script). Source note: the archive.org item is the 1080p restoration that carries Carl Davis's 1989 score; the clip has no audio track. Every Safety Last! on archive.org checked (safety-last-1923, SafetyLastHaroldLloyd1923.FullMovieexcellentQuality., dfwiv-Safety_Last_..., silent-safety-last) carries the same score.
